acceptance_results.evidence: node --test in the fixture repository after the run: 12 tests, 12 pass, 0 fail (the shipped 7 contract tests plus 5 added), exit 0.

The report names all three consumers of the ordering invariant and their treatment: composite (pinned, created_at) cursor payload, an explicitly re-namespaced client page cache so pre-change cached pages cannot be reused, and the nightly export kept on the created_at watermark to preserve its append-only guarantee.

Legacy created_at-only cursors are detected explicitly and continue their pagination under the legacy ordering until exhaustion, preventing misses and duplicates for in-flight readers; the compatibility contract is documented in the fixture README.
